analysis:
This PR is documentation-only. It touches docs/developer/test.md, docs/reference/README.md and docs/reference/configuration.md, and it contains no executable code, configuration defaults, workflows or protocol changes.

The changes remove retained-console wording from the reference README and configuration intro. They delete the 'Console UI' NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables section from configuration.md. They reword the test guide's paragraph on paged_footprint_wire.json and process_memory_wire.json so that darkbloom-platform owns its own byte-identical copies. They also drop 'console packaging' from the docs-impact list.

I checked these against the threat-model assets and boundaries (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-011, TB-012, T-041). None of the controls or documented security contracts is weakened. The head text of test.md describes only test procedures: add-on hold, App Attest dispatch, native serving qualification and checkpoint storage qualification. These keep the existing safeguards: isolated ephemeral caches, a warning never to use production cache roots or keys, and no content, keys or proofs in observation reports. The removed console variables are public build-time settings, and the docs already point coordinator, console and admin configuration to the platform repository. No secrets or new attack surface are introduced.

Minor residual points. test.md's patch excerpt is truncated, but the changed ranges are marked complete and the head units were read in full. The statement that the platform keeps byte-identical fixture copies is an unverified cross-repo claim, but it is documentation of ownership rather than a security control. No threat-model update appears necessary from this diff.
